newsitem.title: USA: Brooks Fiber to offer service in Arkansas.
newsitem.headline: Brooks Fiber to offer service in Arkansas.

text.p: Brooks Fiber Properties Inc said its Brooks Fiber Communications of Arkansas Inc subsidiary was granted authority to provide a full range of local exchange telecommunications services in Arkansas.

It said the authority granted by the Arkansas Public Service Commission allows the company to expand its local offerings. It provides a range of telecommunications services, from high speed connections between businesses and their long-distance carriers to videoconferencing.
Brooks provides local telecommunications services in medium-sized cities across the United States.
